lab.title: Operational Templates
lab.purpose: Reusable protocols for diagnosis, controlled execution, change review, and decision traceability.
rules: Do not jump from symptom to solution.
Separate containment, correction, prevention, and validation.
Use a known-good comparison when possible.
Keep hypotheses testable and record rejected hypotheses.
A root cause must explain the observed evidence.
Close on a validated business outcome, not only a technical status.

templates.title: Root Cause Analysis
templates.use_when: A problem is important, recurring, or not explained by the first fix.

templates.title: Incident Triage
templates.use_when: An active issue needs safe recovery and fast isolation.

templates.title: Integration Failure Analysis
templates.use_when: An API, IDoc, RFC, event, queue, file, EDI, middleware, or external-service flow fails or produces the wrong result.

templates.title: Process Deviation Analysis
templates.use_when: A business object follows the wrong route or produces the wrong business result.

templates.title: Procedure / Runbook
templates.use_when: Repeated operational work should be executed consistently and safely.

templates.title: Change Impact Review
templates.use_when: A change to configuration, code, data, workflow, integration, jobs, or platform may affect connected processes.

templates.title: Decision Record
templates.use_when: An architecture or process decision has meaningful trade-offs or long-term consequences.

templates.title: Cutover / Hypercare Control
templates.use_when: A go-live, migration, major release, or process activation needs coordinated readiness and controlled execution.
